reviewer: Independent data-pipeline agent; train.py reviewed read-only, no training or evaluation executed for this review.
scope: Source-code inspection against the frozen numeric design and written protocol, including legacy primitives; not a substitute for the engineering smoke and final outcome audit.

checks.evidence: design.INHERITED_KEYS and assertions; legacy source_lr, adapt_lr, optmake and step
checks.finding: n=10, four layers/width256/eight heads/vocab188; source4800 and adaptation800; source warmup100/cosine to2400 then flat; adaptation warmup100/cosine through800; AdamW(.9,.999),epsilon1e-8,decay.01,clip1; inherited answer-plus-teacher-EOS loss.

checks.item: Strict paired inputs and task slots
checks.finding: Identical unit-specific sampling RNG reset in every condition. Each step samples64 distinct pool indices and shuffles16 copies of each of4 slots. Common tasks occupy fixed slots0..2. Actual observed index/slot hashes are compared against independent deterministic schedule reconstruction. Separate shared dropout seeds are reset across conditions.

checks.item: Complete source load and target-only reset
checks.finding: Strict state_dict loading is checked with full state hashes. Only the fixed_points tied embedding/output row is overwritten from the same unit initial checkpoint; tensor equality checks every other value and shared data_ptr checks the tie. All parameters remain trainable.

checks.item: Fresh adaptation optimizer and independent starts
checks.finding: Every route/size/LR starts anew from its own source endpoint or A initial checkpoint. AdamW is newly constructed and has zero state entries. Resumption restores only the same identified run, never another sample size or LR.

Atomic checkpoint replacement stores model, optimizer, NumPy generator, CPU/CUDA RNG, step, curves, exposure counts and adaptation best selection. Resume checks identity and frozen protocol hash, restores all state, and reconstructs the already-consumed sampler digest. Dropout train mode is restored by each legacy step.

Two-token greedy horizon; exact match requires the correct first answer and greedy EOS next. For a correct first token, the teacher-forced second pass equals the greedy pass; incorrect first-token rows receive a separate greedy pass. Premature/missing EOS fails. First-answer accuracy and teacher-forced EOS remain separate bridge metrics; answer CE uses gold answer at the causal prompt position.

Step0 is diagnostic only. Candidate best key is negative full-answer accuracy, answer CE, earliest positive step. Cross-LR choice appends declared LR index. All360 completed candidates and best/endpoint file hashes are checked before freezing exactly120 selections. The selected LR endpoint is retained separately.

Official select requires all360 candidate records and bound best/endpoint checkpoint files; non-A candidates require source completion. Test input creation requires exact120 distinct unit/route/size records, unique run IDs, status=frozen, training_complete=true and a valid freeze timestamp. Unified evaluation validates data/selection bindings and checkpoint hashes.
checks.boundary: The low-level data gate checks selection manifest structure and declared training_complete, not each checkpoint directly. It is not a cryptographic proof of training completion if called with a manually forged or manually assembled manifest. Use the official train.py select output; a partial/incomplete genuine manifest is rejected. Original and test manifests are immutable; partial data generation refuses overwrite.

checks.finding: Training and selection access only source/target train/dev pools; tests are generated separately after selection freeze. No source endpoint selection, task replacement, LR extension, or test-dependent choice is present.

mathematical_proofs.proof: For v=p_i, i is a right-to-left maximum iff every w>v occurs before i. Equivalently p_inverse(w)<p_inverse(v)=i for every w>v, which says position v is a right-to-left maximum in the inverse. The bijection i to p_i preserves the count.
mathematical_proofs.verification: No historical exhaustive check was repeated; the existing certificate is reused.

mathematical_proofs.proof: Every left-to-right maximum except the first position is preceded by an ascent. Thus L-1 is at most n-1-descents.
Every right-to-left maximum except the last position is followed by a descent. Thus U-1 is at most descents.
A position is both a left and right record iff it contains the global maximum. The two position sets intersect in exactly one position and their union has at most n positions.
